study type: Review and experimental study (in vitro and animal model)
exposure: Transplantation of various cell types (bone marrow-, adipose tissue-, peripheral blood-, cardiosphere-derived cells; skeletal myoblasts; differentiated pluripotent stem cells)
Ectopic expression of transcription factors (Gata4, Hand, Isl1, Mef2, MesP1, Nkx2-5, Tbx5)
Combination of Gata4, Mef2c, Tbx5, Hand2 (GHMT)
Direct intramyocardial delivery of viral cocktail (GMT or GHMT)
Combination of Tgf-b and Wnt inhibitors with GMT retroviral cocktail
All-chemical approach for inducing cardiomyocyte-like cells
outcome: Enhanced reprogramming efficiency of fibroblasts to iCMs
Dispensing with genetic factors for reprogramming
Potential for genomic integration and tumorigenesis
cohort: N/A (The experimental work described involved mouse fibroblasts, human fibroblasts, and a mouse myocardial infarction model.)
finding: Combining chemical inhibitors (Tgf-b and Wnt inhibitors) with conventional genetic reprogramming significantly enhances the efficiency and quality of fibroblast-to-cardiomyocyte conversion, improving cardiac function and reducing scar formation in a mouse MI model and human fibroblast reprogramming.
